title: The 59 seconds that made flight
idea: Agency is a skill: two bike mechanics proved it by flying.

scenes.spoken: Fifty-nine seconds. That's how long the first real flight lasted.
Newspapers said humans would not fly for a million years.
scenes.visual: Newsprint headline with a red stamp

scenes.spoken: So the brothers built their own wind tunnel and tested two hundred wings.
scenes.visual: Wing profiles flicker inside a tunnel

scenes.spoken: Engines were too heavy, so they built a one hundred eighty pound one.
That is high agency. And you can learn it.
